methodology.corpus: Pinned 5eTools v2.37.0 Spell JSON under src/main/resources/data/spells, joined to the current 7.4.4A inventory by exact source and name.
methodology.ownerCounting: Each spellId is counted at most once per family, even if multiple entry strings or fields match. Family counts overlap and must not be summed.
methodology.evidenceLocations: JSON pointers are rooted at the source spells array, for example /spell/97/entries/0; structured pointers use the source array index and field name.
methodology.evidenceMatching: Structured source fields are matched exactly where listed. Prose is scanned in entries and entriesHigherLevel with family-specific lexical cues and reviewed examples; counts are discovery candidates, not asserted extraction eligibility.
methodology.classification: Classification is joined from the existing inventory record and does not change inventory output.
methodology.baseline: The inventory JSON is authoritative for identities, classifications, processed owners and potential typed claims. Current typed claim count (228) is cross-checked against the roadmap and current inventory report narrative.
